runtime.execution: Synchronous staged generator/diff-improvement pipeline through LangChain model invoke/stream-to-stdout, plus fresh local Popen processes; no generic model tool-dispatch loop or resident runtime.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns project FilesDict/disk stores/logs and subprocess execution; consumes a model provider. File-backed memory is not shared database/compute governance.

summary: A functional code-generation/entrypoint/diff-repair pipeline with injectable stages, clarification, clipboard provider option and bounded generated-application self-heal. Pipeline/model editing must be distinguished from a general coding-agent action loop or governed harness self-improvement.

inspection.scope: CLI selection→injected staged agent→concrete provider invoke/normalization→file/diff parse/applicability repair→disk writes/execution/results; self-heal, fresh preprompts, append/archive logs, opted-in human review/telemetry, benchmark assertion path and relevant functional/no-oracle tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. LangChain provider internals and detailed diff algorithm/version-manager paths are outside trace. No reference tests ran. Source-inferred operational concerns: blocking stdout/stderr reads occur before deadline checks; kill lacks reap, self-heal has unbounded communicate and stops for code 2; benchmark supplies timeout as positional stdin argument.

actions.name: generated file blocks / chat_to_files_dict
actions.lifecycle: host parses one generated response then later writes/executed files; not individual file tool calls
actions.authority: model chooses textual names/content; operator-selected staged generation

actions.name: generated unified diffs / improve_fn
actions.input: selected existing files and improvement prompt; response diff blocks
actions.lifecycle: bounded requery for faulty diffs, accumulated changes then operator apply prompt
actions.authority: model proposes file modifications; host parses/applies; operator CLI final apply confirmation

actions.name: generated run.sh / execute_entrypoint
actions.surface: model response convention plus operator-triggered execution
actions.input: entrypoint/install script fenced content and generated code files
actions.output: combined execution console output; original FilesDict returned
actions.lifecycle: single blocking run after default consent; script can launch arbitrary programs but no native workflow handles
actions.authority: model writes script, operator default Y/n execution confirmation; direct host API may bypass

actions.name: SimpleAgent.init / improve; CliAgent.init / improve
actions.input: Prompt, FilesDict and injected model/memory/env/stage functions
actions.lifecycle: staged pipeline with optional clarification/lite/self-heal; no universal next-tool loop
actions.authority: host programmer/operator, normal model cannot replace stage functions

actions.name: self_heal
actions.output: FilesDict after repeated run/repair or ten-attempt bound
actions.lifecycle: automatic application execution→improve for failures; no timeout passed to communicate; exit 2 stops repair
actions.authority: operator selects --self-heal; model repairs generated application, not harness execution machinery

actions.name: clarified_gen / lite_gen
actions.input: operator specification and clarification replies, or main prompt
actions.lifecycle: clarification synchronously prompts operator until model says nothing unclear, then generates
actions.authority: operator selects generation variant; provider/model informs questions

actions.name: DiskExecutionEnv.upload / download / popen / run
actions.input: FilesDict, command string and optional run timeout
actions.output: downloaded files, raw Popen handle or stdout/stderr/returncode tuple
actions.lifecycle: fresh OS process; run has blocking-read/timeout and reap limits; caller owns raw popen lifetime
actions.authority: host API unrestricted local execution, not a persistent shared kernel control plane

actions.name: AI.start / next / ClipboardAI.next
actions.input: system/user or message list, optional prompt and step label
actions.output: normalized appended model response/messages and usage counters
actions.lifecycle: synchronous provider invoke/backoff; clipboard waits operator EOF/paste
actions.authority: host-selected one provider/model; no native live peer roles

actions.name: PrepromptsHolder.get_preprompts / custom preprompts
actions.lifecycle: reread when stage invokes getter; improvement loop captures prompts before refinement retries
actions.authority: operator/host can edit ordinary files; not executable hot reload/refit

actions.name: DiskMemory.get/set/log/archive_logs
actions.input: string/path key and content or rendered log
actions.output: persisted files and timestamped appended text
actions.lifecycle: stores code/debug/diff/session logs; startup moves logs to timestamp archive
actions.authority: host API; model has no general standing DB/query tool

actions.name: opted-in human review / collect_learnings
actions.surface: operator feedback and supplied telemetry primitive
actions.input: ran/quality/usefulness answers and comments plus prompt/model/config/logs
actions.output: human review/learning payload, bounded optional telemetry send
actions.lifecycle: post-generation interaction, logs may truncate before send
actions.authority: operator consent; no model complaint or tracked external issue DB contract

actions.name: benchmark.run
actions.input: tasks, initial code/prompts, commands and assertion callbacks; optional timeout
actions.output: per-task assertion booleans/success rate and generation duration
actions.lifecycle: sequential improve→execute→assert; timeout positional argument source concern
actions.authority: host-supplied oracles; not measured model-governed harness autoresearch

filesystem.detail: Model-generated file blocks and unified diffs become FilesDict and filesystem writes; selected files constrain improvement inputs, without native per-file observation/edit actions. Binary pull uses a marker.

processes.detail: Host API runs/popens fresh local processes and generated entrypoints execute after consent. run blocking per-pipe readline precedes timeout and kill lacks wait/reap; raw Popen is not a managed model handle.

code_actions.detail: The model emits complete programs/launch scripts which the staged host parses, writes and executes; self-heal repeatedly runs generated application code. This is staged code execution, not tool-cell orchestration.

persistent_kernel.detail: DiskExecutionEnv starts fresh subprocesses; stored files/memory and raw Popen do not establish a persistent namespace kernel or shared client-service protocol.

standing_database.detail: DiskMemory is file-backed keyed text/log storage; host can read/write it and reuse project files. No model-accessible arbitrary standing DB or external shared DB contract is established.

workflow_programming.detail: CliAgent accepts injected generation/improvement/processing functions and interchangeable AI/memory/env; clarification and self-heal are alternative stages. Host composition is real, normal model agency over workflow definitions is not exposed.

multi_model.detail: Inspected AI builds one configured Azure/OpenAI/Anthropic provider; no successive routing, independently active roles or multi-model request program established in staged pipelines.

live_collaboration.detail: No peer mailbox/channel/shared room or model-addressed colleague action established in staged agent/model/clarification/execution paths.

concurrent_work.detail: Host popen returns an OS handle and generated Unix script can compose programs, but inspected staged agent/benchmark execution is sequential with no ongoing-work scheduler or ownership registry.

steering_interrupt.detail: Default execution prints Ctrl+C guidance and kills its direct process when KeyboardInterrupt occurs; it does not wait/reap or preserve model/provider/program state for continuation. Operator clarification/apply prompts are separate boundaries.

turn_redefinition.detail: Programmer injects generation/improvement/process callables and replaces AI/env/memory. That is a staged functional interface, without normal model hot turn completion/admission/compaction redefinition.

compaction.detail: Nonvision AI collapses same-role messages and retains only first text block for list content. This is formatting normalization with potential representation loss, not managed compaction with choices/events/repair.

context_repair.detail: Selected source files, rendered append logs and host message objects can be reused/reinjected by programmer/operator. No model-authorized original-context restore/merge operation; message normalization drops metadata.

original_audit.detail: Append logs/archive preserve rendered conversations/debug/diff information, but generation logs after provider response and does not capture original request/stream/program lifecycles. Message collapse rewrites representation; feedback telemetry may truncate logs.

audit_query.detail: File-backed logs/source and API key retrieval permit ordinary analysis. No native audit query/index service with original complete event records established.

hot_change.detail: Preprompt files are reread when each stage calls get_preprompts, while refinement captures messages/prompts for its loop. Function injection remains host mutable Python state, without executable watcher/activation protocol.

rebuild_continuity.detail: No executable refit, outpost context handoff or restoration of unresolved provider/program handles established in AI/staged agent/memory/execution lifecycle.

remote_services.detail: Consumes configured LangChain OpenAI/Azure/Anthropic provider objects with streaming stdout callback; clipboard adapter is operator-mediated provider input/output. Dependency implementations are not inspected.

self_improvement.detail: --self-heal performs bounded generated-application run/repair. It does not alter/measure/select/reinhabit the harness; unbounded communicate and exit-code-2 stopping rule further delimit success claims.

complaints.detail: Opted-in human review records generated-code quality/comments and sends learning telemetry. It is operator feedback, not model rageshake with captured agent state and external bead/DB tracking.

authority.detail: Default entrypoint execution and CLI improvement application ask approval. Operator-selected self-heal directly executes generated application without that default prompt; direct environment API is host authority. No expert change-activation contract is supplied.

evaluation.detail: Benchmark supplies task assertion callbacks and success rates; functional source tests check exact generated/improved file output. Several complex-diff tests have no assertions and interrupt only checks mock kill; benchmark passes optional timeout in communicate input position.

time_order.detail: Logs/timing use wall time; rate-limit backoff bounded. Execution run timeout cannot bound blocking readline waits and self-heal communicate is unbounded. No causal clock/event chronology foundation supplied.

evidence.claim: CLI selects standard/lite/clarification generation and self-heal/default execution, then constructs injected CliAgent with disk memory/environment and preprompts.
Improvement changes require operator apply confirmation; standard generation runs initialization, collects opted-in human feedback then stages/writes generated files.
SimpleAgent initialization generates code then entrypoint; improve applies a generated diff without using its execution_command parameter.
CLI agent injects generation/improvement/process functions and owns AI/memory/execution/preprompt objects.
CLI init chains generation→entrypoint→selected execution; improve uses injected improvement stage and does not run commented-out entrypoint stage.
gen_code sends system/user request, logs rendered returned messages, and converts textual file blocks into FilesDict.
gen_entrypoint requests one Unix launch/install script, extracts fenced blocks as run.sh and logs rendered messages.
Default execute_entrypoint asks operator consent then uploads/runs bash run.sh and returns original file dict; process output is not fed back in this standard path.
Improve sends selected files/prompt, salvages valid diffs and re-prompts boundedly for malformed hunks; this validates applicability, not behavioral correctness.
Generated textual file blocks are regex-parsed, filenames normalized and inserted as content strings; no ordinary model tool catalog/action handle exists.
FileStore pushes names/content to filesystem and pulls text recursively, replacing undecodable binary content with a marker.
Programmatic upload/download and popen supply raw OS subprocess handles; no agent-owned process registry is provided.
run polls then synchronously reads stdout.readline and stderr.readline before checking timeout; kill on timeout/KeyboardInterrupt has no wait/reap and terminal output drain is not guaranteed.
Nonvision conversation normalization rebuilds collapsed same-role messages from extracted text, taking only the first text block of list content.
AI.next invokes provider, records token usage and appends a response; normalized returned messages are distinct from original input message metadata.
Model invocation is synchronous through LangChain, with bounded OpenAI rate-limit backoff, not a managed asynchronous request handle.
Configured provider object is Azure/OpenAI/Anthropic with stdout streaming callbacks; selectable providers do not establish multiple active colleagues.
Clipboard adapter serializes messages to clipboard/text file and accepts operator pasted response, appending one AIMessage.
Preprompt holder rereads all prompt files through DiskMemory for each getter call, allowing stage-boundary prompt updates.
DiskMemory appends timestamped rendered text logs and archives prior logs at startup; it is files rather than a standing query database.
Self-heal loops up to ten generated-application runs with unbounded communicate, asks improve_fn for failures, and treats returncode 2 as a stopping result; timed_out flag never changes here.
Clarification is an operator/model question-answer loop, then a generated-code pass; it has no live teammate or programmable scheduler.
Opted-in human review asks generated-code ran/quality/usefulness/comments questions; this is operator feedback, not model complaint capture.
Telemetry extracts learning/logs and truncates oversized logs before retrying send; optional collection is not comprehensive core audit.
Human review collection sends learning only when consented review exists; no normal model-native rageshake operation.

Benchmark sequentially improves tasks, runs command and applies supplied assertion callbacks to files/process/output. communicate(benchmark.timeout) passes timeout as first positional input rather than timeout keyword.
Benchmark defines optional timeout and assertion functions; task result success rate counts literal true assertions, with empty assertions yielding zero.
Two functional tests run mock-model generated/improved code and require exact output-file content for generation and changed behavior.
Interrupt test only asserts mock kill invocation; output test targets popen/communicate mocked return values, not run pipe draining or reaping.
Several complex-diff tests invoke salvage without result assertions; some print outputs, so they offer no independent correctness oracle.
Cleanup test asserts True, providing no cleanup oracle.

tests.focus: Generated and changed code must produce independently specified output.
tests.oracle: Mock-model program is run and exact output.txt is asserted Hello World then reversed text; this checks generated program behavior, not provider correctness or execution deadlines.
Interrupt only checks MagicMock.kill invoked; output test directly checks mocked popen/communicate bytes. Neither checks live exit/reap, skewed pipe deadlock, terminal output drain or timeout.
Several cases invoke salvage or print returned files without correctness assertions; cleanup assert True is no oracle. Do not count nominal examples as conformance.

strengths: Injected generation/improvement/processing callables make the staged host interface simple to vary.
Fresh preprompt lookup and append/archive rendered logs are useful small primitives with explicit stage-level scope.
Selected-file diff applicability repair separates model proposals from host application and supplies concrete diagnostics for retry.
limits: LangChain provider internals and detailed diff algorithm/version-manager paths are outside trace. No reference tests ran. Source-inferred operational concerns: blocking stdout/stderr reads occur before deadline checks; kill lacks reap, self-heal has unbounded communicate and stops for code 2; benchmark supplies timeout as positional stdin argument.
arconaut_questions: How should model-program outputs become tracked actions with durable original audit before execution and operator change activation?
Can independent asymmetric-pipe/deadline and child-exit oracles replace nominal mock kill checks?
What measurement decides that application self-heal or harness autoresearch improved behavior rather than only making a process return?
How can fresh prompt-file lookup preserve model continuity and explicit activation after current turn/workflows?
Which minimal functional stage interface supports model-owned programs without requiring a full fixed pipeline replacement?
